searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he awtsmoos drive · website maker the awtsmoos renews every file, route, domain name, connected machine, and responsive vessel in each instant; awtsmoos.com makes drive the visible workshop where ordinary source becomes a public website without hiding the boundaries between configuration, local reflection, mutation acknowledgement, server facts, dns verification, runtime health, and browser evidence. guided website maker open /apps/drive/, connect an alias, and use the persistent website maker studio. the experience is one guided journey rather than five unrelated forms: source readiness proves whether real index.html source exists. preview readiness records whether the current source has actually been rendered locally. public readiness reflects canonical publication testimony. domain readiness stays locked until canonical publication and then becomes explicitly optional. the readiness cockpit always names the next useful action. before any account snapshot arrives it truthfully starts at needs source, not previewed, not published, and publish first rather than displaying generic unknown badges. five step workspace the numbered stepper preserves the existing build / preview / code / publish / domain service boundaries while making their relationship clear: build saves an optional private brief, creates blank/landing/portfolio/docs source, and shows the real source inventory. preview renders current index.html in a sandboxed responsive frame and is visibly labeled as a local preview. code edits real source files rather than a proprietary page format. publish emphasizes one primary canonical publication action while advanced publication options and agent help remain behind native disclosure controls. domain claims and verifies an optional custom hostname through server attested ownership, dns, routing, and tls testimony. local preview is never presented as public publication. canonical publication does not require a custom hostname. ownership, route state, tls state, and external browser health remain separate gates. responsive drive shell drive uses explicit zero minimum grid tracks so wide file controls, website maker content, tables, and project tools cannot expand the entire page beyond the viewport. the narrow layout keeps the application shell inside the true 390 css pixel viewport, uses a fixed safe area aware website maker stepper, and keeps primary touch actions at least 44px high. desktop preserves the two column overview and converts the website maker stepper into a sticky rail. browser agent api window.geelooysitebuilder v1.2 exposes source, preview, publication, domain, and nameserver actions without dom scraping. response protocol v3 preserves old envelope keys while adding invocation, contract, evidence, and lifecycle. caller request ids are correlation only; mutations currently provide no server idempotency guarantee and should be reconciled before replay. result evidence separates server facts from external verification. a dns verification action may carry dns ownership verified when the resolver actually observed the proof record. route/tls states remain server facts unless stronger external testimony exists. dns migration worksheet project settings preserves portable a, aaaa, cname, txt, mx, caa, srv, and ns records as configuration intent. this worksheet is not itself a dns mutation. keep dns at the current provider unless a real provider adapter or deployed nameserver service is attested. preserve mx, spf, dkim, dmarc, caa, srv, delegated ns, verification records, and intentional subdomains before migration. read docs/websites/readme.md and tutorial index.md. provider specific migration lives in dns provider playbooks.md; dnssec has its own migration guide. tunnel agents tunnel catalog 3.7.0 exposes publication protocol v1 while preserving historical action result objects. call sitepublishfolder(path, siteid, direct snapshot), inspect the returned canonical publication testimony, and reconcile with sitepublicationstatus after uncertain mutation. verified live is valid only when the returned publication actually carries canonicalverifiedlive: true. connected node runtime a native compute project stores only a portable recipe: cwd, relative entry, port, and public scalar arguments. the actual account owned tunnel machine is chosen live in connected node server. portable project state never stores machine identity and never silently starts a process. verification covenant the focused website/api/domain/runtime matrix currently carries 78 passing witnesses. real browser verification also checks desktop and true 390px layouts, horizontal overflow, 44px primary targets, one pane stepper navigation, api v1.2 survival, console/runtime exceptions, failed network requests, and http errors. drive ui is one surface. trace behavior through geelooy/api/social/helper/drive/, geelooy/shared/workspace/, geelooy/sites/, ayzarim hosting/runtime modules, and tunnel publication contracts. generated documentation is a locator; source, tests, dns observations, live http, and browser runtime evidence remain authoritative.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he progressive executable examples these examples measure executable emulator capability without hiding boundaries. every artifact is opened through runexecutableartifact; no level receives a format , filename , or product specific execution path. level name formats new capability : 0 identity elf, mach o header and loader inspection 1 syscall hello elf, mach o write and exit syscalls 2 integer control elf, mach o arithmetic, branches, loops 3 stack recursion elf, mach o frames, calls, recursion 4 globals and pointers elf, mach o data segments and relocations 5 windows console pe imports and console host apis 6 windows window pe window creation and event behavior 7 truthful boundary elf, mach o unsupported opcode reporting and semantic fallback run the corpus: the output is deterministic json. actualevidence distinguishes loader inspection, instruction subset emulation, semantic simulation, and errors. a mismatched level remains visible in the report rather than being deleted or silently reclassified. the awtsmoos creates every rung and every limitation anew. awtsmoos.com treats this corpus as an executable capability ledger, not as evidence of complete windows, linux, macos, cpu, dynamic loader, framework, or graphics compatibility.

searchText: b"h merkava executor css support audit this is the working checklist. the native c host must not implement these as browser logic; each item belongs in merkavaexecutor and should emit render ops that c maps to opengl. implemented / started basic selectors: type, id, class, attributes, descendant, child, adjacent sibling. basic pseudo selectors: focus, checked, disabled, enabled, first child. inline style cascade over stylesheet rules. basic box paint ops: background color, text color, width, height, min height, padding, margin, border width. basic block and inline ish flow. linked and inline css collection for fetched network html. linked and inline script collection for fetched network html. color normalization to opengl safe hex for named, short hex, long hex, rgb(), rgba(). first flexbox pass: display flex/inline flex, row/column, gap, justify content, align items. browser like ua defaults instead of fake per element white boxes. per side margin, padding, border width, border color expansion. background and border shorthand normalization. viewport units: vw, vh, vmin, vmax. calc() arithmetic for px, %, em/rem, and viewport units. fixed, absolute, and relative positioning basics. transform translatex()/translatey() basics, including offscreen sidebar patterns. flex grow and margin auto footer style flows. inherited typography basics: font size, font family, line height, text align, white space. text wrapping and center/right alignment. replaced element sizing for img/canvas. pseudo element rules are ignored instead of being applied to real elements. native stream now distinguishes border from filled box ops. missing css rules / features full cascade origins, inherited properties, !important ordering, media queries, @supports, @layer, @scope. full selector grammar: general sibling, :not, :is, :where, :has, nth child family, pseudo elements. css variables and calc()/min()/max()/clamp(). complete units: vw, vh, vmin, vmax, ch, ex, lh, percentages per property, font relative metrics. box model: per side margin/padding/border, box sizing, border styles, border radius. full colors: hsl(), hsla(), lab(), lch(), color mix(), currentcolor, transparent alpha compositing. typography: font family fallback, font size, weight, style, line height, letter spacing, wrapping, white space. layout: full flexbox algorithm, grid, absolute/fixed/sticky positioning, floats, z index/stacking contexts. overflow: scroll containers, clipping, hidden/auto/scroll, scrollbars. backgrounds: images, gradients, repeat, size, position, attachment, multiple layers. transforms: translate, scale, rotate, matrix, transform origin, 3d transforms. effects: opacity, box shadow, text shadow, filters, backdrop filter, mix blend mode. transitions/animations/keyframes. forms and replaced elements: image sizing, canvas intrinsic sizing, video/audio/object/embed. tables, lists, columns, writing modes, directionality. responsive viewport behavior and container queries. svg styling integration.
